title: Courses by field and start time
description: A table of this term's courses filtered by field (STEM or non-STEM, by department) and by when their sections start (morning, after noon, or evening), listing each course's matching section times and open seats. Selecting a course opens it in course detail.

options.any: Courses in every department, when the request does not mention STEM or non-STEM
options.stem: Only STEM courses: computer science, mathematics, statistics, the natural sciences and engineering
options.non-stem: Only non-STEM courses, such as humanities, arts, social sciences, languages and business

options.any: Sections at any time of day
options.morning: Only sections that start before noon
options.after-noon: Only sections that start at noon or later, afternoon and evening together, for requests like after noon, after lunch or in the afternoon or later
options.evening: Only sections that start at 5pm or later

options.any: Every matching section, full or not, whenever the request does not ask about availability
options.open: Only sections that still have open seats, when the request asks for courses that are open or not full

origin.request: Show me the courses that are after noon that are non-stem.
